newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Cargo handling suspended in Bangladesh port.
newsitem.headline: Cargo handling suspended in Bangladesh port.

text.p: Nearly 8,000 dock workers are refusing to handle cargo at Bangladesh's southeastern Chittagong port following a labour dispute, port officials said on Friday.
The workers stopped handling cargo on Thursday following news that coaster hatch workers would be allowed to handle cargo at the port.

They said coaster hatch workers, who are not listed as port workers, normally handled only cargo for small local ships outside the port. These workers are now seeking jobs in the port, the officials said.

"The registered dock workers are scared of losing jobs if the hatch workers are allowed to work in the port," said one port official. Port authorities called meetings with two labour unions to settle the dispute, the officials said. "I don't think the hatch workers will be allowed to work in the port at this stage. I hope the dock labourers could be pursuaded to resume their work soon," said another official.
